Question: Can other political cards be used as votes on an issue instead of to
start a vote? or are they only worth 1 vote on thier own issue?

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Nat B. Baldwin <nat@dunder.com> wrote:
>Question: Can other political cards be used as votes on an issue instead of to
>start a vote? or are they only worth 1 vote on thier own issue?

Any player can burn political cards during any vote to gain the extra
votes.  Keep in mind that once the vote starts, no one replaces any
cards they use until the action has concluded.
